members.name: value
members.doc: The tokens, in order, when the caller controls them.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The tokens the field starts with, when it controls itself. Form reset restores them.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the token array each time the tokens change, and only then: typed text that is not yet a token does not call it. A disabled or read-only field does not call it.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the field: it can be neither focused nor changed, and it submits no tokens.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the field read-only: its tokens stay visible and focusable but cannot be changed, and it still submits them.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named field submits one entry per token under it.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: Text shown while the field holds no tokens and no typed text.

types.name: MuxUIAccessibleName

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which also names the field. Without one, the field needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.
